title: PR workflow skips runtime tests and strict doctor gates
description: Evidence: .github/workflows/npm-publish-dry-run.yml runs install, pnpm check, npm smoke, and dry-run only; package.json exposes pnpm test and doctor:strict, and README documents both as hardening gates. Impact: PRs can pass the only workflow while breaking runtime behavior covered by Vitest or strict workspace diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: CI runs pnpm test on PRs and includes a fixture-backed non-mutating strict doctor gate.
Package smoke/dry-run remains after runtime gates so release packaging is tested only after core health passes.
closedReason: Runtime and strict-doctor gates now precede release packaging in PR CI, with 525 tests passing.
